title: Security Prepayment on Repeatedly Suspended Parking Licenses
content:
Notes to the Parking License collections schedule: a license whose privileges have been restored before carries a security prepayment in its cure amount.

## Note

When two or more reinstatement fees were billed on the license in the 24 months before the handling date, the security prepayment months are 1.0; when exactly one reinstatement fee was billed in those months, the security prepayment months are 0.75; in every other case there is no security prepayment. The security prepayment — the security prepayment months times the prepayment fee — is added to the cure amount.

A reinstatement fee line on the license records an earlier restoration of suspended privileges.

## Months by history

| Reinstatement fees billed on the license in the 24 months before the handling date | Security prepayment months |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.0 |
| exactly one | 0.75 |
| none | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical prepayment fee of $95.00)

- Two earlier reinstatement fees: 1.0 multiplied by $95.00, a security prepayment of $95.00.
- One earlier reinstatement fee: 0.75 multiplied by $95.00, $71.25.
- A reinstatement fee billed 30 months ago and none since: none.
